issues.description: In problem_statement.md, the task text asks students to implement addGuestStudents(String), but the UML diagram in the same statement specifies addGuestStudents(int), and the reference solution implements addGuestStudents(int). Following the task text would lead students to implement the wrong parameter type and fail compilation/tests expecting an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Update problem_statement.md Part 2, task 7 to require addGuestStudents(int) (not String), aligning it with the UML and solution; optionally clarify the parameter name (e.g., numberOfNewGuestStudents).
